name: Zero-Indexed Final Cycle Trap
description: We define time in 0-indexed cycles so that a process of length X ends on cycle X - 1. The failure condition is framed as "the final cycle is T or greater" (i.e. X - 1 >= T), which is mathematically identical to the original X > T. Models relying on surface pattern matching will likely translate "is T or greater" directly into `X >= T` (missing the -1 offset) and fail on boundary cases.
